article.summary_es: CCCS Bronx Food Pantry es una despensa de alimentos en el Bronx, aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad. Abre miércoles y jueves a viernes.
article.summary_en: CCCS Bronx Food Pantry is a food pantry in the Bronx, listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. It is open Wednesdays and Thursday to Friday.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
Está ubicada en 402 E 152nd St, Bronx, NY 10455.
Abre los miércoles de 4pm a 6pm y jueves a viernes de 10am a 12pm.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 402 E 152nd St, Bronx, NY 10455.
It is open Wednesdays 4pm-6pm and Thursday-Friday 10am-12pm.
